name: Ezra T. Benson
role: Apostle who led a pioneer company west
dateNote: He was ordained an apostle on 16 July 1846 and named in section 136 on 14 January 1847.
importance: Section 136 tells him and Erastus Snow to organize a company for the journey west. He went with Brigham Young’s first pioneer company, arriving in the Salt Lake Valley on 24 July 1847. He later sat in the Utah legislature and presided over the Cache Valley stake.
connections: He worked with Brigham Young and Erastus Snow. He was baptized at Quincy, Illinois, in 1840.

sources.title: Ezra Taft Benson, Joseph Smith Papers

reviewNote: Birth, death (3 September 1869, Ogden), baptism, apostle ordination, 1847 company, and later offices checked on JSP. The batch note says he was great-grandfather of the later Church President Ezra Taft Benson; this was not on the loaded page, so it is left out.
